Ava P. (Product): Quick sync: flagship customer wants p99 down by ~45% for chat pilot. This touches runtime kernels, infra prewarm, platform canary, and security masking. Need owners & rough ETA to update roadmap.

Rajat (Eng Runtime): We can target this with two runtime changes: kv prewarm + selective kernel mode. Estimate ~7 dev-days + 1 full perf campaign. Need sanitized prompt set.

Maya (Infra): We'll add a short-lived warm-node pool and extend scale-in grace. Provision + test = ~5 infra-days. Also need cost approval for burst capacity.

Liam (Security): I'll run masking/telemetry checks once we get sample payloads. Initial review ~2-3 days. Legal may be needed for retention exceptions.

Ken (Eng Platform): Canary plan: internal -> 1% -> 10% with automatic fallback on p99 regression. I can wire routing & tracing in ~4 days. Need INF ticket for canary route.

Priya (Solutions): I'll coordinate with customer CSM for sample payloads and confirm acceptance criteria.

deploy-bot: Note: Canary route creation requires an INF ticket reference.

Ava P. (Product): Proposed acceptance criteria: p99 down >=40%, error rate change <0.1%, security sign-off, cost delta <30%. Target pilot in 3 weeks, +1 week contingency. Owners: runtime=Rajat, infra=Maya, security=Liam, platform=Ken, solutions=Priya.

Rajat (Eng Runtime): Acknowledged. I'll open PERF-700 and queue perf run once prompts are in.

Maya (Infra): I'll open INF-5010 for warm pool and attach cost delta.

Liam (Security): Ack. Post checklist when samples arrive.

Ken (Eng Platform): I'll reference INF-5010 in the canary PR.

Ava P. (Product): Thanks team. Next check-in Wed after perf run. Keep notes short in the linked issues. :rocket:
